links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy with vs without LLM support across explanation formats
links.effect: Chain-of-thought explanations improved diagnostic accuracy by 12.2% vs control (P=0.001); +7.2% vs standard output (P=0.040); +9.7% vs differential diagnosis (P=0.004).
links.quote: The chain-of-thought explanations yielded the best performance, improving the diagnostic accuracy by 12.2% compared to the control condition without LLM support (  P = 0.001).

links.outcome: Effect of LLM explanation format on radiologists' diagnostic accuracy
